# international-patient-summary

> International Patient Summary (IPS): an introduction in 45 locales, its website, a browser viewer (frontend), a storage service (backend), and iOS and Android apps.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): contents and how the projects fit together
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): rules for every project, supply-chain policy, verify commands
- [Dependabot](.github/dependabot.yml): weekly updates with a two-day cooldown

## Projects

- [Website](international-patient-summary.github.io/README.md): SvelteKit 3 + Lily Design System site on GitHub Pages; builds its own llms.txt
- [Viewer (frontend)](international-patient-summary-ui-with-svelte/llms.txt): Svelte 5 IPS viewer with JSON/YAML/Markdown/PDF export and a backendless tour
- [Service (backend)](international-patient-summary-service-with-axum/llms.txt): Rust Axum + Axa 0.19 + sqlx + Postgres store for IPS document Bundles, behind Keycloak or PASETO tokens
- [iOS app](international-patient-summary-app-with-swift/llms.txt): Swift + UIKit (no SwiftUI) IPS viewer; saved on the device only, encrypted; no network
- [Android app](international-patient-summary-app-with-kotlin/llms.txt): Kotlin + Jetpack Compose IPS viewer; saved on the device only, encrypted; no network
- [Mobile app translations](international-patient-summary-app-translations/README.md): both apps' strings in 65 languages, and the script that writes them in

## Content

- [Introduction (en-US)](locales/en-us/index.md): the one-page IPS introduction; other locales under locales/<code>/
